title: BANJO'S WORLD OF CARS
tickerText: BANJO IS AN AUSTRALIAN SEAGULL WHO WORKS AT THE TIP AND EATS AT McDONALD'S MOST NIGHTS. HE LIKES CARS, CAR PEOPLE AND GENERALLY STICKING HIS BEAK INTO THINGS THAT DON'T REALLY CONCERN HIM. HE'S NOT A MECHANIC, A CAR JOURNALIST OR PARTICULARLY QUALIFIED TO JUDGE ANYTHING, BUT HE KNOWS WHAT HE LIKES. OLD CARS, WEIRD CARS, FAST CARS, FORGOTTEN CARS — THEY'RE ALL FAIR GAME. BANJO'S WORLD OF CARS IS WHERE HE COLLECTS THE ONES WORTH A LOOK, INCLUDING CARS SENT IN BY PEOPLE WHO RECKON BANJO MIGHT APPROVE. PULL THE LEVER AND SEE WHAT TURNS UP. GOT A CAR HE SHOULD SEE? SHOW BANJO. IF HE REALLY LIKES IT, YOU MIGHT EVEN SCORE A BANJO'S CHOICE AWARD. HE'S A SEAGULL, SO DON'T TAKE IT TOO PERSONALLY EITHER WAY.
